basic_details.total_vacancies: Assistant, Junior Personal Assistant (JPA), Upper Division Clerk (UDC), Stenographer
basic_details.short_information: Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO), through the ISRO Centralised Recruitment Board (ICRB), has released the ISRO ICRB Recruitment 2026 Notification on 27 July 2026 on the official website isro.gov.in. A total of 244 vacancies have been announced for Assistant, Junior Personal Assistant (JPA), Upper Division Clerk (UDC), and Stenographer posts under Level 4 of the Pay Matrix.

important_dates.answer key publication: Within 3 working days of the Written Test
important_dates.window to raise objection on answer key: Within 5 days of answer key publication

application_fee.details: Application fee for all posts is ₹100. However, all candidates must initially pay a processing fee of ₹500 per application, uniformly. | Fee is payable only online through the Bharatkosh e-Payment gateway via Internet Banking, UPI, or Debit Cards (domestic). No other mode of payment (cash, cheque, draft, money order, IPO, etc.) is accepted. The processing fee is refunded in full to candidates exempted from the fee (women, SC/ST/PwBD, Ex-Servicemen) who appear in the written test/CBT; for all other candidates, ₹100 is deducted and the balance refunded, provided the candidate appears in the written test/CBT. Refund is not considered if a candidate fails to appear for the written test/CBT.

age_limit.details: Age reckoning date: 16-08-2026 UR/EWS category: Maximum 28 years (born on or after 17-08-1998) OBC category: Maximum 31 years (born on or after 17-08-1995) SC/ST category: Maximum 33 years (born on or after 17-08-1993) Age relaxation as per Government of India orders is applicable to serving government employees, Ex-Servicemen, Persons with Disabilities, meritorious sportspersons, widows, divorced women, and women judicially separated from their husbands who have not remarried.

qualification.details: Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply.

how_to_apply: Applications are accepted online only, through the ISRO website, between 27-07-2026 (10:00 AM) and 16-08-2026 (11:55 PM).

Candidates may apply for more than one post, subject to conditions. A candidate may apply for different posts under the same or different zones but cannot apply for the same post in different zones. Candidates applying for multiple posts must select the same written test centre.
Email ID and mobile number are mandatory in the online application; all hall tickets, call letters, and communications will be sent only via registered email/SMS, with no hard copies sent separately.
Candidates registered under the National Career Services (NCS) portal and meeting eligibility conditions may follow the same application process on the ISRO website.

Candidates must upload a recent colour passport-size photograph (not older than 6 months, .jpg/.jpeg, 20–50 KB, 200x230 pixels preferred) and signature (.jpg/.jpeg, 10–20 KB, 140x60 pixels preferred), along with SC/ST/Disability/Ex-servicemen certificates where applicable.
Applications not conforming to the notified requirements, or incomplete applications, will not be considered.
important_instructions: Candidates employed under Central/State Government, PSUs, or Autonomous Bodies must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer at the time of the Skill Test. Failure to submit the original NOC will result in the candidate not being permitted to appear for the Skill Test, and TA will not be paid. PwBD candidates applying for reserved posts must submit a self-attested Disability Certificate in the prescribed format, indicating percentage of disability (minimum 40% relevant disability required for reservation eligibility), issued by a duly constituted Medical Board. OBC candidates must possess a valid OBC certificate (non-creamy layer, in the prescribed proforma) as on the last date of application. EWS candidates must possess a valid Income and Asset Certificate for financial year 2026–2027. Candidates attending the Skill Test will be reimbursed second-class railway fare (to and fro, shortest route) from the city indicated in the application to the Skill Test venue. No TA is payable for the Written Test. All original documents must be produced at the time of the Skill Test in support of details furnished online. False information will result in disqualification from the Skill Test, and TA will not be paid. Answer keys will be published on the ISRO website within three working days of the written test. Objections, with valid justification, may be raised only through the designated link within 5 days of publication; objections received after this window or through any other mode will not be considered. Appointees are liable to be posted or transferred to any Centre/Unit of the Department of Space/ISRO at any time, based on requirement. The number of vacancies indicated is provisional, and ISRO reserves the right to increase, decrease, or not fill the posts without assigning any reason. The posts are temporary but likely to continue. Any court case or legal matter arising from this recruitment falls under Bangalore, Karnataka jurisdiction. Canvassing in any form will result in disqualification. Candidates are advised NOT to take cognizance of any fake offer of appointment for jobs in ISRO. In case of ambiguity between the Hindi and English versions of the notification, the English version shall be treated as final.

content_sections.text: Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply.

rows.educational_qualification: Graduation with a minimum of 60% marks or CGPA of 6.32 on a 10-point scale from a recognized university, completed within the stipulated duration of the course, AND proficiency in the use of computers.

Graduation with minimum 60% marks or CGPA of 6.32/10 (completed within stipulated duration) OR Diploma in Commercial/Secretarial Practice with the same marks criteria plus one year of experience as Steno-Typist/Stenographer; AND a minimum speed of 60 words per minute in English Stenography; AND proficiency in the use of computers. (Apprenticeship Training Certificate under BOAT/NATS for DCP/DCCP holders is considered equivalent to one year of Steno-Typist/Stenographer experience.)

content_sections.heading: ISRO ICRB Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: A single objective-type paper of 150 minutes duration (with compensation time for PwBD candidates) will be conducted at 38 venues across India, including Agartala, Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Bhopal, Bhubaneshwar, Chandigarh/Mohali, Chennai, Dehradun, Delhi, Ernakulam, Gorakhpur, Gurugram, Guwahati, Hyderabad, Indore, Jaipur, Jammu, Jodhpur, Kanpur, Kavaratti, Kolkata, Lucknow, Mangaluru, Mumbai, Mysore, Nagpur, Patna, Port Blair, Pune, Raipur, Ranchi, Shillong, Tiruchirapalli, Thiruvananthapuram, Varanasi, Vijayawada, and Visakhapatnam. Marking pattern: +1 for correct answer, -0.25 for wrong answer. No TA is paid for attending the written test. Based on written test performance, candidates are shortlisted for the skill test in the ratio of 1:5 (maximum) to the category-wise number of vacancies. Final selection is based on marks scored in the written test, from among candidates who qualify in the skill test. In case of a tie, tie-breakers are applied in order: (a) marks in General Intelligence & Reasoning (Post 1,3,5) or English Language & Comprehension (Post 2,4,6); (b) date of birth, with the older candidate preferred.

content_sections.heading: ISRO ICRB Last Date to Apply Online
content_sections.text: The online application process for ISRO ICRB Recruitment 2026 started on 27 July 2026 at 10:00 AM and will remain open until 16 August 2026 at 11:55 PM. Candidates who meet the prescribed eligibility criteria are advised to complete the registration process well before the last date to avoid last-minute technical issues. Applications are accepted online only through the official ISRO website. Applicants should ensure that all required documents, including their photograph, signature, and applicable certificates, are uploaded correctly before submitting the application. The application fee must also be paid online on or before 16 August 2026 for the application to be considered complete. Direct Link to Apply Online for ISRO ICRB Recruitment 2026

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are announced under ISRO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: ISRO has announced 244 vacancies for Assistant, Upper Division Clerk, Junior Personal Assistant and Stenographer posts.

faq.question: Q2. Can any graduate apply for ISRO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Graduates can apply, but they must satisfy the prescribed marks, course-duration and computer-skill conditions. JPA and Stenographer applicants must also meet the stenography requirements.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for ISRO JPA and Stenographer posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess the prescribed graduation degree or eligible diploma qualification. They must also have computer proficiency and an English shorthand or stenography speed of at least 60 words per minute.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for ISRO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 28 years for UR candidates, 31 years for OBC candidates and 33 years for SC/ST candidates, subject to post reservation and applicable rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for ISRO Assistant, UDC, JPA and Stenographer posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will be appointed at Level 4 of the Pay Matrix with a minimum basic pay of Rs. 25,500 per month, along with applicable Central Government allowances.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for ISRO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Written Test. Additional post-specific stages will be conducted as mentioned in the detailed official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for ISRO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: All candidates initially pay a processing fee of Rs. 500/-, of which Rs. 100/- is the actual application fee. The remaining amount is refunded to candidates who appear in the Written Test, with full refund for women, SC/ST, PwBD and Ex-Servicemen candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Where will selected candidates be posted?
faq.answer: The vacancies are distributed across ISRO centres and units located in Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Hassan, Hyderabad, Mahendragiri, New Delhi, Sriharikota and Thiruvananthapuram, along with applicable autonomous bodies.

faq.question: Q9. Is computer knowledge compulsory for ISRO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. Proficiency in computer use is required for all the advertised posts.
